targetDiagnostics.message: Resources must have unique names. Resource name 'PolicyAttestation' is used by both '/{resourceId}/providers/Microsoft.PolicyInsights/attestations/{attestationName}' and '/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/providers/Microsoft.PolicyInsights/attestations/{attestationName}'. Provide a unique resource name when instantiating the resource operations.

recommendation.text: Give the operation set containing `getAtSubscription` a distinct logical resource name such as `PolicyAttestationSubscription`. Pass that name through the `AttestationSubscriptionOps.Read` invocation using its `OverrideResourceName` argument, or add a `ResourceName` parameter to the containing interface template `Attestations` and forward it consistently to every lifecycle/list operation for this resource.
